description: v7 (2026-09-26): carries the closure the voice conversation-list pipeline's `transcript_source: "plaud"` mode loads. In that mode harness/voice_conversation_list_cli.mjs dynamically imports guild_hall/voice_capture/semantic_labeling.mjs (buildVoiceSemanticLabelRun) to cut the PLAUD provider transcript into rule units in memory; a v6 build has no guild_hall/voice_capture/ and stops with voice_plaud_semantic_labeler_unavailable. Added tracked_paths were taken from the computed import closure of every .mjs entry point below (static, re-export and dynamic relative imports), not from a hand list: voice_capture/{semantic_labeling,local_asr,plaud_ingest,plaud_catalog,voice_capture,voice_timeline_adapter,delivery_receipt}.mjs, shared/python_bin.mjs, shared/source_timeline_annotation.mjs and town_crier/runtime.mjs, plus the JSON schemas those modules read at load time through new URL(..., import.meta.url) (voice_capture/*.schema.json x6, shared/source_timeline_annotation.v1.schema.json) and voice_capture/module.manifest.json. The closure also reaches two third-party packages -- ajv (voice_capture/semantic_labeling.mjs imports ajv/dist/2020.js) and yaml (town_crier/runtime.mjs) -- so, unlike v1-v6, this lane is no longer node:-builtins only: carried_forward_prefixes are ajv 8 with its runtime dependencies (fast-deep-equal, fast-uri, json-schema-traverse, require-from-string) and yaml, the same untracked set continuous-ingress-v1 carries, inherited with per-file proof from a previous lane's manifest (build with --previous-lane <a lane that carries them>). The whisper default (no transcript_source) never loads any of these files. This spec is a separate file so the v6 spec (context_read_lane.spec.json, whose description holds the v1-v6 history) stays buildable as it was; it registers no task and builds no lane by itself.
